reading.title: The Monthly Visitor
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述 Percy Buttons 的上门讨饭故事，而是换到现代社区里的固定来访者：新搬来的孩子第一次遇到每月来收旧电池的志愿者，邻居解释大家都认识她。重点回收 moved / knocked / asked me for / in return for / everybody knows / calls at / once a month，同时明确现代安全边界。
passage: I have just moved to a small building near Green Street. On Saturday morning, a woman in an orange vest knocked at our door. I did not open it alone; I called my father. The woman asked me for old batteries from our drawer. In return for this, she gave us a small calendar about recycling days. Then she put the batteries in a safe box, put the calendar in her pocket, and went away. Later, a neighbour told me about her. Everybody knows Ms Lin. She calls at many homes in our street once a month and always asks for old batteries, because she is a community volunteer.

questions.question: Why was the narrator surprised by the visitor?
options: Because the narrator had just moved to the building and did not know local routines yet.
Because the visitor came from another country.
Because the narrator had already met the visitor every month.
Because the visitor was looking for a lost meal.
questions.explanation_zh: 开头说 I have just moved...，所以叙述者是新来的，还不了解社区里的固定来访。

questions.question: What did the visitor ask the family for?
options: A glass of beer.
A piece of cheese.
Old batteries from their drawer.
Money for a new calendar.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 The woman asked me for old batteries from our drawer。

questions.question: What did the visitor do in return?
options: She sang songs in the street.
She gave them a small calendar about recycling days.
She bought them a safe box.
She told them to move away.
questions.explanation_zh: In return for this 后面写的是 she gave us a small calendar about recycling days。

questions.question: What did the neighbour explain later?
options: The visitor was lost and knocked at the wrong door.
The visitor only came to this home once.
The visitor should not collect batteries.
The visitor was Ms Lin, and everybody in the street knows her.
questions.explanation_zh: 邻居解释 Everybody knows Ms Lin，并说明她每月都会到很多家收旧电池。

questions.question: What modern safety rule does the story show?
options: A child should open the door quickly for every visitor.
A child should call an adult when someone unknown knocks at the door.
Neighbours should never explain local routines.
Community volunteers should only visit at night.
questions.explanation_zh: 文中明确说 I did not open it alone; I called my father，体现现代安全边界。

writing.intro_zh: 今天的仿写抓住 Lesson 6 最值得迁移的五个结构：刚搬到某地、向某人要某物、作为回报、后来邻居解释、以及 once a month 表示固定频率。写现代例句时要记住安全边界：孩子不要独自开门。

patterns.title: have just moved to ...
patterns.source: I have just moved to a house in Bridge Street.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 have just moved to 说明刚搬到一个新地方，所以还不了解周围的人和规矩。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：你刚搬到一个新小区、新街道或新学校，还不熟悉当地情况。
patterns.sample: I have just moved to this building, so I know few neighbours.
patterns.tip_zh: have just moved to 后面接地点；后半句可以自然说明“我为什么不知道”。

patterns.title: asked me for ...
patterns.source: He asked me for a meal and a glass of beer.
patterns.focus_zh: asked me for 表示“向我请求某物”，后面直接接想要的东西。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：社区志愿者、老师或同学向你要一个安全、合理的小物品。
patterns.sample: The volunteer asked me for old batteries from our drawer.
patterns.tip_zh: asked me for 后面接名词，不要写成 asked me to for。

patterns.title: In return for this, ...
patterns.source: In return for this, the beggar stood on his head and sang songs.
patterns.focus_zh: In return for this 放在句首，表示前后两件事是一种交换或回报。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：别人帮忙后，你用一个小行动表示回报。
patterns.sample: In return for this, I helped her carry the boxes downstairs.
patterns.tip_zh: 逗号后面写具体动作；动作要和前面的帮助形成清楚的交换关系。

patterns.title: Later a neighbour told me about ...
patterns.source: Later a neighbour told me about him.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 Later 把故事推到后面，再让 neighbour 解释一个新来的人不知道的情况。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：后来邻居告诉你某个人、某个地方或某个社区习惯的情况。
must_include: Later a neighbour told me about
patterns.sample: Later a neighbour told me about the woman at the gate.
patterns.tip_zh: about 后面接解释对象，比如 the visitor, the shop, the routine。

patterns.title: calls at ... once a month
patterns.source: He calls at every house in the street once a month.
patterns.focus_zh: calls at 表示“到某处拜访或停留”，once a month 表示“每月一次”，合起来写固定的社区、学校或家庭习惯。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个人每月一次到某处做一件固定的事。
patterns.sample: The volunteer calls at our building once a month.
patterns.tip_zh: 频率短语 once a month 通常放在句末，让读者最后看到这个 routine。
